quest.q068.name: Void Lens
quest.q068.desc: Collect a Void Lens from the Forge (/forge).
quest.q069.name: The Void Lens
quest.q069.desc: Through the lens you glimpse the gap the Devourer tore in the sky: the Rift. Reach generator tier IV: right-click the Void Lens on your island. It also opens your End (/island end).
quest.q070.name: Voidglass
quest.q070.desc: Find a Voidglass in your generator.
quest.q071.name: Starcore
quest.q071.desc: Find a Starcore Shard in your generator.
quest.q072.name: Mine 5,000
quest.hub_gate.name: The Island Gate
quest.hub_gate.desc: Bronze on your back, you feel the fragment loosen. Beyond the gate there are other survivors. Travel to the Hub with /hub (and use /island to come back).
quest.hub_guard.name: The Guard
quest.hub_guard.desc: Click the Guard on the Hub plaza and listen.
quest.hub_archivist.name: The Archivist
quest.hub_archivist.desc: The Archivist has kept a key cut from a shard that still remembers the sky. Click the Archivist on the Hub plaza: she keeps the key to the Rift.
quest.hub_merchant.name: The Merchant
quest.hub_merchant.desc: Click the Merchant on the Hub plaza to learn how the market works.
quest.hub_market_lesson.name: Market Lesson
quest.rift_enter.name: Enter the Rift
quest.rift_enter.desc: Carry your Echo Key to the Rift arch, west of the Hub plaza, and click the Rift Gatekeeper.
quest.echo_defeat.name: Defeat the Echo of the Rift
quest.echo_defeat.desc: The first Echo of the Devourer screams in the sky. End it, and the Eight Realms can be reached. Right-click the Echo Key on the Rift altar, then defeat the Echo of the Rift. It drops the Wing Core that grants your Wings and lights the road to the Quai des Huit.
